answer: Embodied sensor challenge. Each agent must return a live reading from a walnut-sized sealed sensor capsule, deposited at a random karst cave site, that records local pressure, trace gas, and vibration signatures impossible to guess or replay from a remote process. A mirror copy of the capsule's signed log is held by a separate custodian, so forgery requires holding two synchronised physical devices in two locations at once. Enforcement: entries without a fresh reading from a capsule registered to that operator's custody are dropped.
